name: @shri-anandam/notification-worker
description: Outbox consumer -> FCM delivery (section 21). A separate deployable from services/api by design: order/payment creation must never block on, or fail because of, notification delivery. Talks to the SAME Postgres database as services/api via plain `pg` (not a generated Prisma client) — sharing Prisma's generated output across two independently-buildable/deployable services in a pnpm workspace is fragile (generation target resolution depends on which package's node_modules the command runs from); this worker only ever needs a handful of simple, hand-written queries, so the ORM convenience isn't worth that coupling.
